昨天发帖说儿子参加理化实验考试的事情——就是走个形式，全员满分。不过英语听力口语考试大概就没那么好糊弄啦。


![9310a695-06b9-4245-8e2f-84d41b13e10c.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcWLFaZc8x4L8eCniztChFyG1Rb5in3unpM3J9KqL1Jx8/9310a695-06b9-4245-8e2f-84d41b13e10c.png)
(插图由ChatGPT辅助生成)


因为和理化实验教师随意给分不同，英语的听力口语一部分是电脑自动判分，对就是对，错就是错，这可没法造假呢。

因为英语听力口语考试也是计入中考总分，学校对这个可是相当重视，不像理化实验完全是放任的状态，英语听力口语一直抓得很紧。

怎么抓的呢？那就是使用一款叫做英语E听说的软件，每周（包括寒暑假）都要留几套听力口语测试，一直坚持了快三年。

这个软件确实也很好用——当然了，不是免费使用的。我感觉儿子的听力口语都得到了很大的提高。

其实儿子小学时，他妈妈就带他听各种英语绘本，有时候也让他朗读，所以说起来，诸多科目中，英语的听力和口语还算是他的强项呢。





![Weixin Image_2026-04-09_171247_782.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQma4G2Z2tm6KA8yb4z3CHm7qr5X4u15UmJrqfpDi43SdqB/Weixin%20Image_2026-04-09_171247_782.png)
(插图由ChatGPT辅助生成)





因为是强项，所以做E听说时就总是很敷衍，有时候人家那边还没读完他就各种答题，各种跳过，原本应该十几二十分钟弄完的事情，他三两分钟就搞定。

对此，虽然我们也告诫过他要好好答题，重视起来，但也没觉得有啥大问题，之所以快，还不是因为会嘛？

不过正是因为我们全体没重视这个事，昨天的英语听力模考就翻车了呢。

儿子回来给我讲述，口语环节回答问题时，都是在滴的一声后开始回答。但是平时他跳（skip）习惯了，又按着旧习惯想跳过去，但是考场不提供跳过去的选项，他一疏忽，没等滴声响起，就开始回答。

等到滴声想起来，他才发现自己搞错了，然后慌乱地重答，过程中，把会读的单词也读错了。他为此非常沮丧。

我倒是觉得通过模拟考试翻车发现问题是大大的好事呢，不然直接到考场上实战再发生这样的问题，可就是真的惨了呢！

现在发现，以后再做E听说的时候重视起来，规规矩矩地答题，不去毛毛躁躁地跳过，就可以轻轻松松地避免这样的问题。


![2655d2b3-27fe-4e51-b600-7134ed26c5e1.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTyY5mo5wyTi6iAX2CA5kTr8NrQYPqa4aRQWoDA6VeXGR/2655d2b3-27fe-4e51-b600-7134ed26c5e1.png)
(插图由ChatGPT辅助生成)

儿子听我这么说，总算不那么沮丧，开心了一点点呢。然后给我说考场上的趣事，比如有个同学被考试用的大耳麦把头夹迷糊了，考试后直接请假回家。

哈，竟然这么夸张，我说一定是这娃原本就身体不舒服吧？儿子说不是，是这个女孩头比较大，所以夹得比较紧。晕，他竟然这么说人家小女孩，若是被人听到，不得挠他呀，哈哈哈哈。

早晨在等地铁时，边上四个老太太，约莫6、70岁的样子，旁若无人地大声说着话，说到高兴处，有老太太甚至大声地笑出声，这真是应了那句话，如果你不尴尬，尴尬的就是别人。

等地铁马上进站时，这几个老太太立马停止了讲话，其中一个老太太，迅速地插队到队伍的最前边，虽然排队的人不多，但这也太。。。明目张胆了吧。

好吧，这还不算，等地铁门一开，那老太太以百米冲刺的速度，第一个抢先冲进地铁车厢，找到个位置坐下来，坐下来的那一瞬间，还迅速地用手挡住边上的位置，那意思再明确不过：

这位置是我占的，别人休想坐这里！

等到其他几个老太太上车厢坐下后，又是一阵吵杂声，说话声，笑声。。。完全不顾及其他人。

其中一个穿大红颜色服装的老太太坐下来后，跟那位先冲进来占座的老太太笑着传授着占座的更好“秘籍”，

“下次你应该拿你那个包，（把包）往边上一放，这样（占座）更好！”

其余几个老太太，则掏出手机，打开短视频，放着大声的外音，好似回到自己家里，有说有笑地攀谈起来。。。

妈呀！这几个老太太这般操作，一看就知道都是江湖老手，个个都不是省油的灯。


![04_02_012.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSGkYiFgqr6CJRNEXrV6hLf4byCA69trZw1JZXq4GNgeb/04_02_012.jpg)

![04_02_018.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdi8cYW8pFFu6xScV7aB7LsgSrJJ7d2cub9cikFMLSfQp/04_02_018.jpg)

![04_02_019.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmR4GaEnondKUpNPdB4c7Rcrrddy3aimS2ZMPAcz4uUKth/04_02_019.jpg)


有古语言：**老吾老，以及人之老。** 意思是说要尊老。但我看像这些老太太的样子，公众场合丝毫不顾影响和他人感受，旁若无人、极度的自我、自私行为，完全令人没法尊重的起来啊。

希望我等老年后，千万莫成为这种老太太的样子，实在令人心生厌恶。像这般行为行径，也怪不得有些老人得不到年轻人的尊重。

这，没法尊重起来啊！

result.body: i've always been a shy writer who moonlights as a part-time balcony gardener. i like the dirt, i just don't got the guts to truly and properly dig down, even when my soul calls out for it. or maybe that's not right. i got the courage to dig, i just don't always know what to do with what i find there, so end up stuffing it back into pots and hangers and other lovely, adorning things. they call it plant propagation or taking cuttings. when i first found it, i thought it was a wonderful thing. we tend to see rebirth in view of dying things. so the first time i found it, it was merely a means of saving what had already been lost. put an unlucky stem in water, it can begin sprouting roots, and in time, transition into a new home. i think now it may have been something to do with where i was at, in my personal life. in strange, terrible ways my past seems much more filled with loss than my present has been, and yet, i'm nowhere near where i was. once. back in the when, i used to think this propagation business was only useful for things that were already dying. a way to save. playing god games -- though isn't the world full enough of mad tyrannts doing just that, already? i think i was trying, in my own haphazard way, trying so hard to establish some kind of order, bring sense to what surrounded me. i thought there was something rather marvelous in taking a thing that was dying and helping it find roots to live again. i carried on. some of my green thumb salvages did, also. others died. but that's just the way of things and people, sometimes. found somewhere the time to create a beautiful world to surround myself with, but it didn't come easy, and it hardly felt natural at first. taking care of things is just something that women do. i learned that from my grandmother. i salvaged her kitchen cactus after she died. i kept with it all the unspoken things she had given me. in time, i healed and with it, grew more bold. i started learning about taking cuttings not as a means to evade death, but as room to grow. experiments began on orchids, because aren't they already so unknowable and difficult and wonderful, in the same beat? i messed up several times, like humans will. are you supposed to cut above or below a budding stem? how low is low? will the plant be offended by my shears? i treated it still as a shame and hide-worthy things, my having sharpness and fangs, my hunger and my improper knowledge of nurture. still, i persevered. i got brave, started daring more, and learned to recognize when a plant was craving space, cuttings, the interstices where new life can bloom. it's a real act of courage, snipping off shoots for new life to exist. recognizing which parts must be relegated (or, at times, even killed) in order for new life to grow. it's not always an easy thing. neither is trusting in water. and you gotta trust in water, in empty spaces, for new things to grow. how awkward and against human instinct is that... i'm getting better at it. watching water. waiting for roots to sprout. trusting that things will come when there's nothing, that absence (also) serves a purpose. yesterday, i spent a day gardening. just in my pots and my balcony, in the absence of full-blooming gardens, but still. i snipped the tallest shoot off my coffee plant, the one i've been growing lovingly for years after a friend surprised me and gifted me some gorgeous red coffee cherries, just to see what they were like. it was an act of courage, though it might not look like it, held up against firefighters and space saviors, and other brilliant things. it was drawing resources, it needed snipping and (hopefully) repotting, so that the rest of the plant could bloom and thicken. for now, it sits as a gorgeous, watery thing. the tradescantia not so much. don't look as good, except to me, because i'm the only one who knows it almost died a few months back, and still somehow managed to not. managed to not only survive its own death (often inevitable) and sprout new shoots. grew too big for its own boots, so i removed it, trusting in its own magic, its own resilience which only i've witnessed. trust, also, a most courageous thing. i find myself arriving in a new space in life, a place where growth doesn't need to emerge only out of impending death. where new things can bloom of their own accord, built on enough trust, and a jar of water. space for potentiality. the unsupposed emergence of wondrous new things. ---- *first time posting here. much as i love my plants, i never dared see myself as a gardener. i don't, for one, have a proper garden. still, perhaps this text can find a home in this place.*

## No Bosses Allowed! (The Global Team) 🌍🤝

Imagine if your favorite video game didn't have a big company making the rules. Instead, every player in the world worked together to keep the game running. That is exactly how **Bitcoin** works!

Most money has a "boss." 
* **Dollars** have a boss in Washington, D.C. 🇺🇸
* **Euros** have a boss in Europe. 🇪🇺
* **Yen** has a boss in Japan. 🇯🇵

But **Bitcoin has no boss.** It doesn't live in a fancy skyscraper in New York or a big bank in London.

### The Team in Your Neighborhood 🏠
Bitcoin lives on thousands of computers all over the planet. 
* One computer might be in a **bedroom in Tokyo**.
* Another might be in a **sunny office in Hawaii**.
* Others are in snowy mountains or busy cities!

All these computers are connected like a giant, invisible web. They are a **Global Team** of volunteers. Because the "brain" of Bitcoin is spread out everywhere, no single person, king, or government can turn it off or change the rules.



### Why "No Boss" is Awesome! 🚀
Since the community runs the show, Bitcoin is **fair**.
1.  **It stays open 24/7:** The "Global Team" never sleeps! You can send Bitcoin on Christmas morning or at 3:00 AM on a Tuesday.
2.  **No Borders:** It doesn't care if you are in the USA or Africa. It treats everyone exactly the same.
3.  **Power to You:** You don't have to ask a bank for permission to join the team. If you have a computer and the internet, you can help keep the "Notebook" safe too!

### 🔍 Fun Comparison: The Pizza Party
Imagine a pizza party where **one person** (The Boss) decides who gets a slice and how big it is. If they don't like you, you might get no pizza! 🍕🚫

Now imagine a **Bitcoin Pizza Party.** Everyone brings their own toppings, everyone helps cook, and everyone agrees on the rules together. Nobody can hide the pepperoni or take all the cheese, because everyone is watching the oven! 🍕✅

---

### 🎮 Discussion Quest: "Who's the Boss?"
Think about things in your life. Which ones have a "Boss" and which ones are "Run by the People"?
* **Your School?** (Has a Principal Boss!)
* **A Public Park?** (Run for everyone!)
* **The Internet?** (A giant team of everyone!)

**Bitcoin is the first money that belongs to the whole world, not just one country.**

---

Link Your Existing Account to MetaMask ======================================================= _Keep your history, gain a new way to sign in._ * * * If you've been on Hive for a while - whether through Ecency, PeakD, or any other Hive frontend - you already have an account with a set of cryptographic keys tied to it. You don't need to start over to use MetaMask. Ecency lets you add MetaMask as an additional signing method to your existing Hive account. Here's what that means and how to do it. * * * How It Works ------------ Hive accounts support multiple sets of keys. When you link MetaMask to your existing Hive account, Ecency generates a new set of keys associated with your MetaMask wallet and adds them alongside your existing keys. The result: **your account now has two ways to log in and sign transactions**: 1. Your original Hive keys (unchanged, still fully functional) 2. Your MetaMask wallet (new, added via this process) Nothing is removed or replaced. You can use either method going forward. * * * What You'll Need ---------------- * Your existing Hive account credentials (posting key, active key, or master password) * MetaMask installed and set up with at least one active wallet * * * Step-by-Step: Link MetaMask to Your Hive Account ------------------------------------------------ ### 1\. Log In to Ecency with Your Existing Account Go to [ecency.com](https://ecency.com) and log in using your current Hive keys or Keychain. * * * ### 2\. Go to Account Settings Navigate to your **Profile Wallets** or by **directly going** look for the [**Link Metamask**](https://ecency.com/wallet/setup-external) section. * * * ### 3\. Connect Your MetaMask Click **Link MetaMask**. Your browser will open the MetaMask prompt asking you to connect. Approve the connection. * * * ### 4\. Authorize the Key Addition Ecency will ask you to sign an authorization using your existing Hive keys to confirm that you own this account and are approving the addition of new keys. This is a one-time step to prove ownership. Once confirmed, the MetaMask-linked keys are added to your Hive account. * * * ### 5\. Benefit

Sign transactions the way you already do across Web3

The new MetaMask-linked keys are separate - they are simply an additional authorized set for your account. As always, keep your MetaMask seed phrase and Hive master password safe and offline. * * * Welcome to the Full Ecency Experience ------------------------------------- Whether you're a longtime Hive user or just arrived via MetaMask, Ecency is built to give you full ownership of your content, your identity, and your assets - across multiple blockchains, from one platform. ## The Two-Token Secret: Trading Cards vs. Piggy Banks 🃏🏦
#
#### Now that you know about your **Super Strength**, you’re probably wondering: *"What kind of treasure am I actually giving and getting?"* In the Hive City, the shopkeepers and citizens use two different kinds of digital money. It might seem like a secret code at first, but it’s actually as simple as looking at your toy shelf!

 # 🃏 HIVE: The Magic Trading Card
#
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmeGbeqZ2kmyQZBh6QETCG8t9JY52wS8JLMPFm5gLz79x5/Screenshot%202026-04-08%20at%202.21.48%E2%80%AFPM.png 
#
 ### 🃏 HIVE: The Magic Trading Card
Think of the **HIVE** token as a rare, shiny **Trading Card**. 

* **It Changes!** Some days, everyone wants this card, and its value goes up high like a kite. Other days, it might dip down. 
* **The Power-Up:** Remember your Super Strength battery? HIVE is the "fuel" you use to grow your battery bigger. 
* **The Investment:** When you hold HIVE, you are betting that the City of Hive will grow and become even more awesome. It’s like owning a special rookie card of a player who might become a superstar!

#

### 🏦 HBD: The "Stable" Piggy Bank
**HBD** stands for *Hive Backed Dollar*. Think of this as your **Super Reliable Piggy Bank.**

* **It Stays the Same:** While the HIVE "trading card" goes up and down, HBD is built to stay worth exactly **one dollar.**
* **No Surprises:** If you have 5 HBD today, you can be sure it will still buy you 5 dollars' worth of treats tomorrow. 
* **The Safe Spot:** This is where you keep the money you want to save for something special, like a new bike or a video game, because you know it won’t lose its value.

### ⚖️ Investing vs. Saving: Which One Do You Use?
In Hive, you get to be a mini-banker! You have to decide how to split your treasure:

1.  **If you want to be more powerful:** You turn your treasure into **HIVE** and "Power Up" your backpack battery. This helps you grow and help others more.
2.  **If you want to buy something soon:** You keep your treasure in **HBD**. It’s safe, steady, and won't change while you’re waiting to spend it.

> **Citizen Tip:** Most heroes in the city keep a little bit of both. They keep some "Trading Cards" to grow their strength and some "Piggy Bank" money for a rainy day!

---

### 🧱 Why Have Two?
Imagine if you went to the store to buy a candy bar, but the price changed every five seconds. That would be confusing!

A walk in the woods is inspiring. After a walk, I feel like doing something. For example, after we went for a walk, I started drawing a new piece of art. After that, I cleaned the house. 
Today, by the way, is Maundy Thursday. It’s the day of cleaning before Easter. I need to wash the windows, mop the floors, and bake Easter bread. There’s a lot of work to do today. 
It’s warmer today than it was yesterday. There’s a light breeze, but it’s pleasant. The sun is warm. But in terms of temperature, it’s colder today than it was before. But things are getting warmer; soon it will be nice and warm, and in the summer it will be downright hot)

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/themyscira/23xyhy9v3c3dsyDiHWkStkHDtsgp2vqX1TX6vQRxv3hMN2qsCofS8asS9mykwJq5MEr1C.png)
Hello, dear friends of gardens and nature. Today I’d like to tell you about my new project: the potato tower. I’m trying this method out for the first time this year, and I’m really excited to see how it turns out. For the first tower, I’ve used the leftover pallets – simply to test the whole thing out. If it works well, I’ve already got a better idea: a tower made of wire mesh, which I’ve already had a look at. But for now, I’m using the wooden structure with good air circulation.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/themyscira/23w2qUxv9ccry1cNncHeJigtXuvnJNkavvLXTh1TKnUMJJYojFWq7AJyN3REeJXibD2Cd.png)


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/themyscira/23xp8m16XpZ6uyXkqh7r1ExcHGNBrtW8hZ82AXHyV9bkRwPtRtRNfbQrEub7iQ6qjYxVN.png)

I lined the tower with unprinted cardboard, of course, which I moistened thoroughly. I then filled it first with wood and garden clippings, followed by leaves and soil. The trick to the whole thing is to work mainly with organic material: garden waste, straw, leaves – and always in rotation. So here, we only build up the mound using whatever nature provides and makes abundantly available.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/themyscira/23z7Bpe6Gg17wiA7z9gANdZ7LFsiYZ6rJ28is5ug2DJ6mUewSairCmiCfeMQUjyw5jG7j.png)

This method is said to be one of the oldest, in contrast to the version commonly used today, which relies almost exclusively on soil. That’s exactly what appealed to me. It means I don’t have to buy, lug about and shovel vast quantities of soil just to give the potatoes room to grow. Perhaps it’s all just wishful thinking – but we’ll only know for sure once I’ve tried it myself. Haha. Then I’ll see how it turns out. I’ve got a good feeling about it, though, and I’ll be busy piling up organic material to grow some splendid potatoes.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/themyscira/23uQpe9uNYzyHMHAAE61msNcMy47iQzKz9P7sqkamJP9w8hH5p6oJGUHKESYmahywBoB7.png)


This tower is now filled with waxy ‘Linda’ potatoes. This is a tasty and very high-yielding variety, ideal for gratins, boiled, fried or jacket potatoes. It is a mid-early variety that can be harvested in the first half of the growing season. So it will be interesting to see – and I will weigh the yield to document the results achieved this year and next.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/themyscira/23yndQxLtrCdPhJqeWKZPSQ51qxh5U38j35YYYs7aks35xaoTEPYiHHcJ6VgsWf9aittq.png)

Every corner of the garden is crying out for attention, and I’m already getting ready to try out the next new gardening technique to make things a bit easier for myself. The materials I need have already been delivered, so now I can get started. I’ll be keeping you updated and sharing both my failures and my great successes with you.

Until then – and until next time. Have a wonderful day, everyone.😍


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/themyscira/EoJy7Ettno6AL13bqisbFaBuq8vK6F4yEwb6ka1JcVeZkLJhxP7XDnD4GRyW5AA1JYW.png)


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/themyscira/23x1DmErJLeZ5G1s2zysn89JZTY2QBz5cDRBnKyP55kCrVW1RzLTMYaGoAsNdwmC91MJf.png)
Thank you for reading my post. 

![2023-08-14 03_48_18-Window.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/themyscira/23wCHvE3hS6oDC1qefwsQHHG2J6GjWXfbThjQDqvQPKasJ5NobMR3FJ7bb57nJdmuFVuA.png)

DE

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/themyscira/23xyhy9v3c3dsyDiHWkStkHDtsgp2vqX1TX6vQRxv3hMN2qsCofS8asS9mykwJq5MEr1C.png)
Hallo ihr lieben Freunde der Gärten und der Natur. Heute möchte ich euch von meinem neuen Projekt erzählen: dem Kartoffelturm. Diese Methode probiere ich in diesem Jahr zum ersten Mal aus, und ich bin sehr gespannt, was sich daraus entwickelt. Für den ersten Turm habe ich die restlichen Paletten verwendet – einfach, um das Ganze einmal zu testen. Wenn das gut funktionieren sollte, habe ich schon eine bessere Idee: ein Turm aus Drahtgeflecht, den ich mir bereits angesehen habe. Aber fürs Erste nutze ich die Holzkonstruktion mit guter Luftzirkulation.

Den Turm habe ich natürlich mit unbedruckter Pappe ausgekleidet, die ich gut angefeuchtet habe. Danach habe ich ihn zuerst mit Holz und Verschnitt aus dem Garten befüllt, anschließend mit Laub und Erde. Der Trick an der ganzen Sache ist, überwiegend mit organischem Material zu arbeiten: Grünschnitt, Stroh, Laub – und das immer im Wechsel. Ange-häufelt wird hier also nur mit allem, was die Natur hergibt und reichlich zur Verfügung stellt.

Dieses Verfahren soll eine der ältesten Methoden sein, im Gegensatz zu der heute üblichen Variante, bei der fast ausschließlich Erde verwendet wird. Genau das hat mich angesprochen. So muss ich keine Unmengen an Erde kaufen, schleppen und umschaufeln, nur um den Kartoffeln ihren Wachstumsraum zu ermöglichen. Vielleicht ist das alles auch nur Wunschdenken – aber das wird sich erst zeigen, wenn ich es selbst ausprobiert habe. Lool. Dann sehe ich, was dabei herauskommt. Ich habe aber ein gutes Gefühl und werde fleißig organisches Material aufschichten, um prächtige Kartoffeln zu erhalten.

In diesem Turm sitzen jetzt festkochende Kartoffeln der Sorte Linda. Sie ist eine schmackhafte und sehr ertragreiche Sorte, die sich gut für Gratins, Salz-, Brat- oder Pellkartoffeln eignet. Eine mittelfrühe Sorte, die quasi in der ersten Halbzeit des Gartenjahres geerntet werden kann. Man darf also gespannt sein – und ich werde den Ertrag wiegen, um zu dokumentieren, welche Ergebnisse dieses und nächstes Jahr erreicht werden.

An allen Ecken des Gartens schreit es nach Aufmerksamkeit, und ich bereite mich schon auf die nächste neue Gartentechnik vor, um mir alles etwas leichter zu machen. Die dafür benötigten Materialien sind bereits geliefert, und nun kann ich beginnen. Ich werde darüber berichten und sowohl Misserfolge als auch große Erfolge mit euch teilen.

Bis dahin erst einmal – und bis zum nächsten Mal. Habt einen wundervollen Tag, ihr Lieben. 😍

皇帝的处境非常被动，他有个垂帘听政的非生母母后和觊觎皇位的皇弟。他在朝堂上的政策常与皇太后相左起争执，如何将皇权完全抓在手里成了他需要解决的大问题。

女主是将军忠良之后，父母兄长全都去世后她在家里的地位也很尴尬。原本她同觊觎皇位的男配有婚约，上辈子她嫁给信王后对方起势成最大赢家，她也过的相对不错。

男女主有点相互救赎的味道，女主帮男主稳固皇权，男主则帮助女主解开当年她父母死亡的真相。在魂穿对方的过程，里两人为了模仿对方的想法和仪态不断了解彼此。

从演员的角度来说，我觉得这部剧反而是男主的演技有吸引到我。虽然他长得不算很帅啦，但他扮演女主魂穿到他身上时候那股劲儿尊嘟很到位，看的时候笑得不行。

总的来说，不算是特别精彩的剧，有时间可以看看啦。

之前一直说我家有个拖延症娃，我就先忍着，待我忍无可忍就得好好教育他了。前些天去春游，那天他玩的开心也没有作业，就说要看会电视再玩会游戏，我也同意了。

结果就是ipad拿到手上就松不开了，让他吃饭他说等一会儿，让他去洗澡他说还有五分钟，让他睡觉他说还有一会儿。我实在受不了了，直接让他在客厅呆着，一晚上不许睡觉。

这个问题已经很严重了，之前一直没有很好的反制措施，我就睁一只眼闭一只眼算了，现在愈发的胆子大，他这个一会儿可不是真的一会儿，是大概半小时，1小时，也就是你若不再喊他，他可以一直拖。

所以我做了个决定，这次要好好惩罚一下，长长记性。我就让他站客厅，不许睡觉，然后我去睡觉，其实我是给了他漏洞的，我并没有在客厅守着他，也就是说他熬不住了是可以睡的，但是只有沙发，一条小薄毯，肯定没有床舒服。

我心里的盘算是这次小惩罚，我放放水，嘴上说的不许睡，我什么时候出来检查你睡了我就再罚，但是我一整晚都不会出来的。那如果以后还不长教训，那我就守在客厅，你是真的不要睡了。

我跟他说，以后我说话结束你就得行动，如果不行动，比如喊你吃饭你不立刻来吃，那这顿饭就不要吃了，喊你写作业不立刻写，那最也就别写了，第二天自己去跟老师解释 自己去学校补作业，含睡觉不立刻行动起来去卧室睡觉，那就一晚上都不许睡。

真的要对他严厉一点了，不然将来被淘汰的必然是他这样自由散漫性格的孩子。
